meaning_en: Advice is a noun meaning a suggestion. Advise is a verb meaning to suggest.
sentence: I advise you to follow your teacher's advice.

meaning_en: Beside means next to. Besides means in addition to.
sentence: Besides English, she teaches Telugu; she sits beside the window.

meaning_en: Breath is a noun (the air taken in). Breathe is a verb (to take in air).
sentence: Take a deep breath and breathe slowly.

meaning_en: Childish means silly and immature (negative). Childlike means innocent like a child (positive).
sentence: His childish behaviour annoyed us, but her childlike joy charmed everyone.

meaning_en: Credible means believable. Credulous means too ready to believe things.
sentence: The credulous villager believed a story that was not even credible.

meaning_en: Decent means proper or respectable. Descent means going down, or ancestry. Dissent means disagreement.
sentence: The decent officer recorded his dissent before the descent of the lift.

meaning_en: Discreet means careful and tactful. Discrete means separate and distinct.
sentence: Be discreet about the discrete parts of the confidential report.

meaning_en: Disinterested means impartial, not biased. Uninterested means not interested.
sentence: A judge must be disinterested; the bored student was uninterested.

meaning_en: Economic relates to the economy. Economical means saving money; thrifty.
sentence: Despite the economic slowdown, an economical car sells well.

meaning_en: Allusion is an indirect reference. Illusion is a false idea or appearance.
sentence: The poem makes an allusion to the Ramayana; the magician created an illusion.

meaning_en: Eligible means qualified. Illegible means impossible to read.
sentence: He was eligible for the post, but his application was illegible.

meaning_en: Envelop is a verb meaning to cover completely. Envelope is a paper cover for a letter.
sentence: Fog may envelop the town; put the letter in an envelope.

meaning_en: Fair means just, or a market festival. Fare means the price of a journey.
sentence: Is the new bus fare fair to students?

meaning_en: Formally means officially. Formerly means in the past.
sentence: He was formerly a teacher and was formally appointed principal today.

meaning_en: Hoard means a hidden store, or to store secretly. Horde means a large crowd.
sentence: A horde of buyers rushed in after news of the trader's hoard of rice.

meaning_en: Human relates to people. Humane means kind and compassionate.
sentence: Every human being deserves humane treatment.

meaning_en: Industrial relates to industry. Industrious means hardworking.
sentence: The industrious workers kept the industrial unit running.

meaning_en: Its shows possession. It's is short for 'it is' or 'it has'.
sentence: It's clear the dog has hurt its leg.

meaning_en: Later means after some time. Latter means the second of two.
sentence: Of tea and coffee, I prefer the latter; I will have it later.

meaning_en: Lightening means making lighter. Lightning is the flash of light in a storm.
sentence: The lightning lit the sky, and the sky was lightening by dawn.

meaning_en: Moral means a lesson, or relating to right and wrong. Morale means confidence and spirit.
sentence: The moral of the story raised the team's morale.

meaning_en: Observance means following a rule or custom. Observation means watching carefully.
sentence: Strict observance of rules needs careful observation.

meaning_en: Pray means to speak to God. Prey means an animal hunted for food.
sentence: The deer became prey to the tiger; the villagers pray for rain.

meaning_en: Prescribe means to recommend or order. Proscribe means to forbid.
sentence: Doctors prescribe medicines; the law may proscribe some drugs.

meaning_en: Respectful means showing respect. Respectable means deserving respect. Respective means belonging to each one separately.
sentence: The respectful students greeted the respectable guests and went to their respective classes.

meaning_en: Statue is a carved figure. Stature means height or reputation. Statute is a written law.
sentence: A leader of great stature has a statue, and a statute was named after him.

meaning_en: Than is used for comparison. Then means at that time, or next.
sentence: Finish the work first, then rest; it is better than worrying.

meaning_en: Their means belonging to them. There means in that place.
sentence: The students left their bags there.

meaning_en: Waive means to give up a right or not insist on a rule. Wave means to move the hand, or a moving ridge of water.
sentence: The college agreed to waive the fee; the students waved happily.

meaning_en: Weather means the condition of the atmosphere. Whether introduces a choice.
sentence: Tell me whether the weather will be fine tomorrow.

meaning_en: Access means a way to enter or use. Excess means more than needed.
sentence: Students have access to the library; an excess of noise is not allowed.

meaning_en: Born means brought into life. Borne means carried or endured.
sentence: He was born poor and has borne many hardships.

meaning_en: Canvas is a strong cloth. Canvass means to ask for votes or opinions.
sentence: Volunteers canvassed for votes under a canvas tent.

meaning_en: Cease means to stop. Seize means to take hold of suddenly or by force.
sentence: The police seized the goods and the illegal trade ceased.

meaning_en: Compose means to make up or create. Comprise means to consist of.
sentence: The committee comprises five members; they will compose a report.

meaning_en: Complacent means self-satisfied and careless. Complaisant means willing to please others.
sentence: Don't become complacent after one success; the complaisant host agreed to every request.

meaning_en: Device is a noun meaning a tool or gadget. Devise is a verb meaning to plan or invent.
sentence: Engineers devise a new device every year.

meaning_en: Exceed means to go beyond a limit. Accede means to agree to a request.
sentence: Do not exceed the speed limit; the officer acceded to our request.

meaning_en: Gait means a way of walking. Gate is an entrance in a wall or fence.
sentence: I recognised his slow gait as he came through the gate.

meaning_en: Ingenious means clever and inventive. Ingenuous means innocent and sincere.
sentence: The ingenious inventor had an ingenuous smile.

meaning_en: Loath is an adjective meaning unwilling. Loathe is a verb meaning to hate.
sentence: I loathe lies and am loath to trust liars.

meaning_en: Persecute means to treat cruelly. Prosecute means to take legal action against.
sentence: Those who persecute minorities should be prosecuted.

meaning_en: Practicable means able to be done. Practical means sensible and useful.
sentence: Her practical idea was also practicable within the budget.

meaning_en: Urban relates to a city. Urbane means polite and refined.
sentence: The urbane officer worked in an urban area.

meaning_en: Vain means proud of one's looks, or useless. Vein is a blood vessel.
sentence: The nurse searched in vain for a vein to give the injection.
